Ugraparipṛcchā
or ugradattaº or gRhapati-ugraº Bud. Sūtra. Ratnakūṭa. AMG. II. p. 216. AR. XX. p. 409. Transl. into Chinese in 181 A. D. an. 252 A. D. Q. in the Śikṣāsamuccaya, ed. by C. Bendall, Ind.-Iranian Reprints, p.. 11, 37, 120, 180 ff. See also J.. 1927, Oct.-Dec. 251.

Ugrabhūti
ref. to by Alberuni (India I. 135) a. ‘teacher of Ānandapāla, son of Jayapāla who ruled in our time’. Latter part of 10th cent. A. D.
--Śiṣyahitānyāsa. gr. Kātantra. BORI. 322 of 1875-76. H. 140. Report XXI. See also Belvalkar, Systems of Skt. Gr. p. 91. Was known in Tibetan; see JASB. 1911, Sup. p. 85.

Ugrabhairavamantra
TD. XX. Sup. no. 976.

Ugrarathaśānti_(ºkalpa,_ºvidhi)
dh. a rite done a. the completion of one's sixtieth year; different texts known. Adyar I. p. 95a. Ānandāśrama 1959. BISM. Nasik Patawardhan 700. Gough p. 183. IM. 3051. Kotah 536. Mysore I. p. 100 (6 mss.). PUL. I. p. 80. Vidyaranyapura 110. [Page284-a.
--according to Bodhāyana. MD. 3571. 3572 (inc.).
--according to Śaunaka. L. 3233. RASB. II. 1420 (i, ii).
--from Śaivāgama, Śiva-Ṣaṇmukhasaṁvāda. L. 3234. MD. 14729. RASB. III. 2574. Rep. Rāj. & C. I. p. 5.
Pt.., one version according to Śaunaka, Poona Ori. XXIII-XXIV, Sup. 1958-59.

Ugrasena
father of Mānāṅka (a. of Vṛndāvanakāvya, IO. 3911).

Ugrasena_Sūri
Jain.
--Jīvavicārasāra. IO. 7525.

Ugrāditya
or ugrAcArya Jain. med. writer, C. 800 A.D. of the Deśīgaṇa, Pustakagaccha, Kundakundānvaya an. Mūlasaṅgha; disciple of Śrī Nandī; wrote his Kalyāṇakāraka in Rāmagiri in Vengi in Trikaliṅga under Eastern Cālukya Viṣṇuvardhana IV. See Jain. Ant. XIX. i. p. 4; also ib. XV. i. p. 43; Praśastisaṅgraha p.. 50-7.
--Kanakadīpaka. med. Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 117.
--Kalyāṇakāraka. med. Arrah II. 20. Mysore I. 362. Praśastisaṅgraha p.. 50-7. TD. 11043 (inc.).
--Jagatsundarī. med. Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 118.
--Bhiṣakprakāśa. med. ib. p. 117.
--Rāmavinoda. med. ib. p. 117.

Ugrāryasūnu
--Jayatīrthastutivyākhyā. Mysore III. p. 4.

Ugrāstravicāra
--from Sudarśanasaṁhitā, Pārvatīśvarasaṁvāda. Rep. Rāj. & C. I. p. 10.
